posts.text: The way I keep describing Fable 5.1 to people is that it just works. I explain what I want in a few vague, messy sentences, and it figures out the rest. It fills in the gaps the way I would have. It's a truly impressive model in so many ways and I hope you enjoy using it!

With Fable 5.1, our team has taken on more ambitious projects that would have previously taken months. What big bets do you want to take? Ask Fable 5.1 in Claude Code, Claude Cowork, Claude Tag to take on the task and let us know what you think!

One non-model thing I'm very excited we announced today with Fable 5.1 is Enterprise Frontier Safeguards (EFS). Even if you're not a CEO/CISO, this blog post is a look into how big companies are thinking about AI adoption which is important to understand if you're interested in

Thanks to your feedback, we’ve unified memory across Chat and Cowork. Now, you can tell Claude to remember something once and it’ll have that context across surfaces! Tell us what you’d like to see next :)
